name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker trains Seismic Smash rank 1 (#7555)
contract: Mathrengyl Bearwalker (creature 4217) is the one CoA class trainer that is a live NPC rather than a
summoned book (rev_20260923_05_coa_class_trainer_core.sql); his gossip option 'I seek training as a
Primalist.' opens the native trainer_spell-backed window for trainer 900031, bypassing mod-spellbook's
BuildRows entirely. Seismic Smash rank 1 (300693, Spell.dbc BaseLevel 59) had no trainer_spell row of its
own even though ranks 2-4 (301276-301279) already required it as ReqAbility1 and no
AscensionCompatData::ClassSpells entry either, so a Primalist could see rank 2 gated behind a prerequisite
they could never buy and never saw rank 1 at all. The fix adds the missing ClassSpells entry at level 59
(matching the DBC BaseLevel, the same convention every other rank-1 row in this trainer follows) and the
matching trainer_spell row. This proves rank 1 is absent below level 59, offered and buyable at 59, and
that buying it unlocks rank 2 once level 62 is also reached - independent of PR #7828's unrelated AP/
Stamina scaling and buff-on-cast changes to the same spell.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
